topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I came across someone who had my artwork tattooed on their skin recently. At first, I was taken aback, but then I felt a deep sense of connection. To see my creation become a permanent part of someone else’s story is both humbling and wonderful. I hope it brings them joy and serves as a reminder of the beauty we can share. If they ever want to meet or chat, I’d love that. After all, it’s not every day you meet someone who carries a piece of your heart right there on their skin.
